en.t: The day passed in a rush.

units.source_text: 次日早晨，薰大将前往参见皇后。

en.t: The next morning, General Kaoru went to pay his respects to the Empress.
Prince Niou also came, as usual.

units.source_text: 他身穿丁香汁染的深色轻罗单衣，外罩深紫色便袍，神情异常风流潇洒。

en.t: He wore a dark, thin silk unlined robe dyed with clove juice, with a deep purple informal robe over it, and looked extraordinarily elegant and graceful.

units.source_text: 他的相貌之美，并不亚于大公主。

en.t: The beauty of his appearance was in no way inferior to that of the elder princess.

units.source_text: 肤色白皙，眉清目秀，比从前略微瘦些，然而非常动人。

en.t: His complexion was fair, his brows and eyes were refined, and though he was a little thinner than before, he was deeply moving.

units.source_text: 薰大将一见这个貌似大公主之人，恋情立刻涌上心头。

en.t: As soon as General Kaoru saw this person who resembled the elder princess, his love immediately surged back into his heart.

units.source_text: 但觉比未见大公主以前更加痛苦了。

en.t: Yet he felt even more tormented than he had before seeing the elder princess.

units.source_text: 匂亲王命人拿了许多画来，吩咐侍女将画送交大公主。

en.t: Prince Niou had many paintings brought in and ordered a maid to deliver them to the elder princess.

units.source_text: 他自己不久也到大公主那里去了。

en.t: Before long, he himself also went to the elder princess's rooms.
